description: Users report being unable to sign in because their account credentials are not accepted.
Users object to basic playback controls and listening features being restricted to Premium subscribers.
Users report missing songs or lyrics and dissatisfaction with music recommendations.
Users report that offline listening does not work and may consider canceling Premium as a result.
Users express general dissatisfaction with the app and intentions to uninstall without identifying a specific product issue.
Users report launch, loading, connectivity, playback interruption, and audio-control failures.
Users report excessive advertisements, unwanted random playback, and removal of basic player features.
